title: Neodustria Phase 19 Canonical Causal Discovery Ablation Suite
description: Rigorous paired ablation over Conditions A through F on unseen Tasks L and N without hardcoded values

conditions.name: Condition A: Classical Blind Adaptive
conditions.description: Blind sequential traversal over canonical topologies without physics memory or scaling models

conditions.name: Condition B: Classical + Discovered Scaling Law
conditions.description: Classical search accelerated by analytical Buckingham-Pi thickness sizing

conditions.name: Condition C: Meta Muse Cold Start (Zero Memory)
conditions.description: LLM structural reasoning proposing hypotheses from first principles without CASM database

conditions.name: Condition D: CASM Memory Only (No Meta Muse)
conditions.description: Pure case-based nearest neighbor retrieval from historical database without generative synthesis

conditions.name: Condition E: Full Neodustria Stack (CASM + Meta Muse + Compositional)
conditions.description: Complete frontier architecture integrating CASM memory, Meta Muse reasoning, and compositional graph search

conditions.name: Condition F: Ablation (Tapering Removed / Uniform Beams Only)
conditions.description: Ablated stack without continuous beam taper mutation, restricting all members to uniform cross-section
